page.layout: One page of text: running head at top; verse lines in one block; a small ornament (woodcut) and a tailpiece mark below the text. No margin notes.

p.i: Quàm rosa grata oculis, qualem rosa spirat odorem,
Quàm gratus puri mellis in ore sapor,
Hac placeat forma, sapiat sic mente habeto,
Vt sit Virginei mox decus omne chori:
Mella rosaque inter sint, manéntque diu.
Vt plures surgant Rosinæ, pluréque Melissi,
Quique suum referant nomine réque genus.

page.notes: The page carries a woodcut ornament (cornucopia with a winged cherub head and foliage) and a printer's mark "†O" between the verse and the woodcut; these are not transcribed as text. Some words in the verse are doubtful due to show-through and faint print: "Quinetiam" and "Melissi" read as printed.
